highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.158.0 pairs Skia m158 rendering fixes with HarfBuzz 15.0.0 and expanded script constants.
highlights_body: The cumulative line improves image-filter sampling, glyph-mask handling, GPU text, and Vulkan synchronization while preserving existing SkiaSharp managed signatures.

bullets.detail: Updates the native renderer to milestone 158 without changing SkiaSharp's managed binding surface.

bullets.lead: HarfBuzz 15 and complete named script coverage
bullets.detail: Updates bundled HarfBuzz to 15.0.0 and adds 30 HarfBuzzSharp Script constants, including Jurchen, ProtoCuneiform, and Seal. Existing Script fields, parsing, and conversions are preserved; the removed deprecated native import was not a public managed member.

bullets.lead: Correct image subsets and glyph masks
bullets.detail: Prevents unrelated texture pixels bleeding into filtered images under antialiasing, minification, and skew, and makes filter-cache equality consistent with hashing. Regenerated mask-filtered glyphs use their own paths, validated formats, and correct clipped emboss-plane strides.

Fixes reflected hairline caps and text-atlas selection, bounds Graphite clip recording, and adds targeted ARM Vulkan device-loss cleanup timing. Native synchronous submission now accounts for fence-wait failures; GRContext.Submit still returns void. Displacement offsets use fp32 arithmetic to match filter bounds.

The shared hash-code polyfill now obtains its per-process seed from OS-backed cryptographic randomness. Hash codes remain stable within a process and randomized between processes; first use now initializes cryptographic services.

contributor_summaries.rolfbjarne: OS-backed randomness for the shared hash-code seed and analyzer enforcement for shipped code.

preview_summaries.v4.158.0-preview.3.26563.17: Preview 3 improves displacement-filter precision and native synchronous Vulkan wait reporting. The shared hash-code polyfill adopts OS-generated randomness while keeping hash codes stable within each process.
preview_summaries.v4.158.0-preview.2.26560.5: Preview 2 brings HarfBuzz 15.0.0 and 30 additional Script constants. GPU fixes cover reflected hairlines, text-atlas selection, Graphite clip recording, and affected ARM Vulkan device-loss cleanup.
preview_summaries.v4.158.0-preview.1.26556.2: Preview 1 introduces Skia m158 without changing managed bindings. HarfBuzzSharp moves to package revision 14.4.0.300 while native HarfBuzz remains 14.4.0.

harfbuzz_summary: Updates bundled HarfBuzz to 15.0.0 and adds 30 named Script constants, including Jurchen, ProtoCuneiform, and Seal. The existing struct-based Script API and values are preserved.

v4.158.0-preview.1.26556.2.headline: Preview 1 introduces the Skia m158 engine with unchanged managed bindings.
v4.158.0-preview.1.26556.2.body: HarfBuzzSharp moves to package revision 14.4.0.300 while the bundled HarfBuzz engine remains at 14.4.0.

v4.158.0-preview.2.26560.5.headline: Preview 2 adds HarfBuzz 15.0.0 and GPU correctness fixes.
v4.158.0-preview.2.26560.5.body: HarfBuzzSharp gains 30 named Script constants. Rendering corrections cover reflected hairlines, text-atlas selection and Graphite clip recording, with a targeted Vulkan device-loss cleanup workaround for affected ARM drivers.

v4.158.0-preview.3.26563.17.headline: Preview 3 improves displacement-filter precision and native synchronous Vulkan wait handling.
v4.158.0-preview.3.26563.17.body: The shared hash-code polyfill uses OS-generated randomness while remaining stable within a process. Managed API signatures are unchanged.
